hero.title: Money, investments and taxes in one place
hero.text: Personal finance tracking and investment portfolio analytics. Monobank sync, envelope budgeting, brokerage accounts and Ukrainian taxes.
hero.note: Ukrainian and English · light and dark themes · no ads

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.text: For people who want to see all their money in one place without keeping spreadsheets by hand.

banks.title: Several banks and currencies
banks.text: Monobank and PrivatBank cards, cash, deposits, credit cards and debts, with the balance in hryvnias at the NBU rate.

investors.title: Private investors
investors.text: Brokerage accounts at Interactive Brokers and Freedom Finance, Ukrainian government bonds and other assets, with returns and allocation.

fop.title: Sole proprietors, group 3
fop.text: Business income from your accounts, the single tax, military levy and social contribution by quarter, and the declaration in the tax service format.

features.title: Features
features.text: From everyday spending to the yearly declaration.

sync.title: Sync and import
sync.text: Monobank through its API, PrivatBank PDF statements, import of past transactions. Review and edit before importing.

categories.title: Categories without the chores
categories.text: Two-level categories, tags and payees. Payee and MCC rules learn from your corrections, duplicates are found automatically.

envelopes.title: Envelope budgeting
envelopes.text: Every hryvnia gets a job, leftovers roll over to the next month. Needs, wants and savings by the 50/30/20 rule.

planning.title: Planning
planning.text: Recurring payments in the feed, a balance forecast months ahead and savings goals linked to Monobank jars.

reports.title: Reports and analytics
reports.text: Spending by category, income and expenses, net worth over time, plan versus actual, period comparison and trends.

investments.title: Investments
investments.text: Lots by FIFO and average cost, IBKR and Freedom trade import, daily prices, TWR and MWR returns, allocation by sector.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.text: Tax on investment income with credit for foreign tax, sole proprietor taxes by quarter, rates per year and declarations as XML for the tax service.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Bank tokens are encrypted in the database. No ads, analytics or third-party scripts on the pages.

independence.title: The road to financial independence
independence.text1: Financial independence is not about a big fortune but about habits: knowing where the money goes, keeping a safety cushion and investing regularly. The hard part is that it usually takes spreadsheets, formulas and the discipline to keep them up for years.
independence.text2: WebWallet does the math: goals are calculated from your real spending and savings, so you see progress every month, not once a year.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.text: How much you really spend and save each month — the basis of every calculation.

fym.title: Safety cushion — FYM
fym.text: Freedom money: how many months your spare money lasts at your usual spending. The target is 6, 12 or 24 months.

compound.title: Compound interest
compound.text: The calculator shows how regular contributions grow over the years and what is left of them after inflation.

fire.title: FIRE
fire.text: The capital whose returns cover your spending forever, and when you reach it at your current pace.

example.caption: Example. The calculations are a guide for planning, not financial advice.

source.title: Source code
source.text: The code of the project is published: a Spring Boot server and a React web client. You can read it and check how your data is stored.
